name: Veg Handi
steps: Cut vegetables into bite-size pieces. Heat oil in a heavy pot, bloom cumin and cook chopped onion for 8 minutes until golden.
Add minced ginger and garlic, then chopped tomatoes, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder and salt. Cook 8 minutes until the tomatoes break down.
Lower heat and stir in whisked yogurt. Add potatoes, carrots, beans and water; cover and simmer 10 minutes, then add cauliflower and peas.
Cook for 8–10 minutes until all vegetables are tender. Finish with cream, garam masala, crushed fenugreek and coriander; heat gently before serving.
tips: Keep the vegetables distinct rather than mashing them; add a splash of water if the handi dries out.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
